summary: Practical municipal finance and local economic development training with Excel-based tools, project appraisal, and council-ready reporting. Enroll today.
lede: Municipal finance connects local revenue, capital decisions, and economic development priorities. For municipal finance officers, budget analysts, and local economic development professionals, the course develops practical skills to assess financial health and revenue performance, appraise capital projects for affordability, and compare development finance options. Exercises also cover local investment assessment, stakeholder mapping, and council-ready reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work at the intersection of municipal budgets, local investment, and economic growth. It is especially relevant if you prepare finance reports, review capital projects, support revenue reforms, or advise leadership on how local resources can fund development priorities. Municipal Finance Officers managing revenue, debt, and budget execution. Budget Analysts reviewing expenditure trends and capital affordability. Local Economic Development Managers coordinating investment and growth initiatives. Revenue Accountants tracking billing, collection, and arrears performance. City Planners aligning infrastructure priorities with finance capacity. Treasury Officers monitoring liquidity and cash flow position. Project Appraisal Specialists assessing public investment feasibility. Economic Development Officers preparing local investment briefs. Council Finance Committee Advisers translating financial data for decision-makers. Public Sector Consultants supporting municipal finance reform and reporting.
prerequisites: You should come with basic familiarity with municipal budgets, local economic development work, or public sector finance processes. A laptop with Microsoft Excel is required for the practical exercises, and you should be ready to work with sample budget, revenue, and project data; all other learning materials and templates are provided during the course.
